main_text.head: EIVSDEM MELISSI MELOS, Ad Amicum quendam.

p.i: SVMMO Iehouæ sacra mea est lyra Summi Iehouæ dum cano filium, Instincta mens sancti calore Numinis, alta volat per astra. Vertumnus haud me lumine adultero, Pellace nec me voce Glycyrrhoa Sub triste Sirenes barathrum Abripient male pertinacem. Cuicunque cura est dia anima salus, Obturet aures atque oculos dolis. Scylla canina monstra fugi Providus & Syculam Charybdin. Speres abyssos irremeabiles, Euphraste, si quem trux gula gurgitum Absorpsit, anfractuosve in imam Præcipitant Styga tortuosi. Christus reducit solus ab inferis Quos vult, & alte cum superis locat: Selegit idem agmen piorum Primigeni Chaos ante mundi. Idem tenebris irradians tuis, Caliginosa nubila dissipulit [?] Mentis, serenatumque luce Ferre dedit super astra pectus.

page.notes: The large initial S is set as a woodcut-style letter joined to "VMMO", read as SVMMO. Line 22, "dissipulit", is partly unclear in the scan (the letters "ssp" are blurred), so it is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Line-initial "Vertumnus" has a spaced capital V. The poem's stanza structure is not separated in print, so it is kept as one paragraph.
